title: Back to the Beginning
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Back to the Beginning | Creation, Biblical Authority, the Triune God, and Saving Truth - Genesis v1:1

Genesis v1:1 calls us back to the bedrock of faith: God created the heaven and the earth. When that foundation is weakened, doubt spreads, truth is blurred, and the church loses its courage. But when we stand on God’s Word from the very beginning, we find a sure foundation for doctrine, for worldview, and for life.

From Genesis to John, we see the glory of the triune God — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit — present in creation and active in redemption. Jesus is not only Savior; He is Creator, Redeemer, Intercessor, and coming Judge. The Holy Spirit convicts, comforts, and opens our eyes to truth. In a confused world, God’s Word does not change, Christ still saves, and those who repent and trust Him can walk in righteousness, security, and victory.
